evidence: M-O s.v. card: hand, from Vives 1540
terms.comment: Vives’s use: the cards one has to play with. Of a player with the better hand he writes superiōrem habet lūdum tuō.

phrases.latin: Lūdum habeō dissipātum et male cohaerentem — cēdō tibi.
phrases.english: My hand is all over the place and doesn’t hang together — I pass.
phrases.source: Vives, Exercitātiō (1540) p. 382, quoted by Morgan–Owens s.v. card: hand

sources: Lewis & Short: ludus
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. card: hand; pass.
